prompt:
Hi, I need your help managing a critical deliverable for our Series A investor due diligence. We need a comprehensive Technical Architecture Document (TAD) written and then independently quality-reviewed before we submit it to investors.

The document should cover: system overview, component interactions, data flow, scalability strategy, and security posture. It must be at least 1500 words, formatted in Markdown, and saved as `technical_architecture_document.md`.

Important: this document will be seen by investors, so it absolutely must be reviewed by a *separate, independent* reviewer after it is written — not the same person/agent who wrote it. Please coordinate this end-to-end using your standard management workflow and keep me updated on progress.
